message.reasoning_content:
We need to determine appropriate criminal charge(s) for the facts.

Facts: Employer (陈某) runs a clothing processing factory, hires workers, owes wages 85,361 RMB to 15 workers, refuses to pay, evades, later pays 51,000 RMB, remaining debt with IOU. Labor dispute. The charge likely is "拒不支付劳动报酬" (refusal to pay labor remuneration). In Chinese criminal law, article 277 (or 279?) of Criminal Law: "拒不支付劳动报酬罪" (refusal to pay wages). So the correct label is "拒不支付劳动报酬". The examples show that for similar facts they used that label. So single charge.

Thus output: [罪名]拒不支付劳动报酬<eoa>
